title: Airport departures board with gate/status cells and track buttons
notes: v2 replaces the <table> board with an <ol role=list> of CSS-grid rows (emotion classes with dev labels) rendered inside an <hx-flight-board> declarative shadow root, re-sorts flights by estimated departure time (delayed and departed flights move), reorders columns (Status before Gate, gate shown as 'Gate B14'), renames 'Track' to 'Follow' and 'Show later flights' to 'Load more departures' (plus a new 'Show earlier flights' button), inserts a 'Connections' tab between Departures and Arrivals, and adds a 'Flights you follow' panel that repeats the status and gate cells of BA 0847 and KL 1182. The search input keeps id='flight-q'.
